source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all seven Hot Zone rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: The Crater
entities.source_summary: Deep rubble remains of Arasaka’s former headquarters, searched by scavengers and guarded by Reckoners; no active commercial operation is established.

entities.name: Dark Zone One
entities.source_summary: Heavily concealed and lethal site associated with possible corporate activity beneath former offices; no public commerce is established.

entities.name: The Dump
entities.source_summary: Wreckage-sorting field and informal squatter settlement where residents scavenge debris; no organized customer-facing trade is stated.

entities.name: Eurasiabank Plaza
entities.source_summary: Ruined former bank tower explored for lost vaults, currency and records; the bank is not operating as a business here.

entities.name: Toggle’s Temple
entities.source_summary: Hidden enthusiast facility with underground practice ranges and obstacle courses available to invited patrons for a nominal fee.

services.label: Use of practice ranges and obstacle courses

entities.name: The N54
entities.source_summary: Ruined former Network 54 tower used as an urban-exploration climbing challenge; no active commercial operation is stated.

entities.name: Safe Child
entities.source_summary: Wreckage of a prewar elite daycare surrounded by rumors; it is no longer an operating childcare business.
